posts.text: 🚨 Morgan Wallen faced controversy after being caught on camera using a racial slur, but despite that moment, he remains @kmichellemusic's favorite artist even after hearing his side of the story. Tap in as K. Michelle explains the first time she experienced racism firsthand in the country music scene. Check out the conversation on @netflix
posts.summary: Defends artist despite racial slur controversy, minimizes incident
